title: The printer starts one-sided
hook: How much paper could a default change save in this print queue?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Trace a duplex setting through sheet counts while leaving document content fixed.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Trace a duplex setting through sheet counts while leaving document content fixed.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: An 11-page toy document prints on one side of each sheet. How many sheets would the same document need when printed double-sided? Toy inputs A=[11, 2]; B=[11, 1].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[6, 11, 2], [11, 11, 1]]. Labels: Sheets, Pages, Sides/sheet.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: Printing two pages per sheet changes the physical sheet count while preserving all eleven document pages. The rounded-up calculation matters for an odd number of pages; it is a mechanical saving, not a measured default effect.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Pages=11, Sides/sheet=1. What is Sheets? Answer: 11.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Pages=11, Sides/sheet=1. What is Sheets?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 11. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Switching a Swedish university's printers to double-sided by default cut paper use about 15% (Egebark & Ekström, 2016).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Trace a duplex setting through sheet counts while leaving document content fixed.
